استظهروا (form X)
# اِسْتَظْهَرُوا (istaẓharū) /is.taðˤ.ha.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# اُسْتُظْهِرُوا (ustuẓhirū) /us.tuðˤ.hi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# اِسْتَظْهِرُوا (istaẓhirū) /is.taðˤ.hi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
